name: Tenstorrent Kubernetes Device Plugin (community)
description: A classic Kubernetes device plugin for Tenstorrent cards, written in Go. It discovers `/dev/tenstorrent/N` nodes, reads `tt_card_type` from sysfs, and advertises them as `tenstorrent.com/blackhole`, `tenstorrent.com/n150`, `tenstorrent.com/n300` and `tenstorrent.com/grayskull` resources. Each allocated container gets its device node, a 1G hugepages mount, a read-only `/sys` mount and `TT_VISIBLE_DEVICES`. Deploys as a DaemonSet or Helm chart, with unit tests and CI; it is a lighter-weight alternative to the official tt-operator stack.
author: OctopusET
